text: 连日来，深圳华强北商圈热度攀升。丰富的电子产品、快速迭代的新品，吸引多国游客前来选购。在华强北，为了迎接国庆假期，很多商家提前上新，新款机器人、AI翻译机吸引很多海外游客驻足。无论是多次到访华强北的熟客，还是初次前来的游客，都感受到了这里火热的消费氛围。 不仅是华强北，深圳围绕入境游客“吃住行游购娱”全场景，全面提升“中国游、中国购”体验。据深圳市统计局数据，2026年1—8月，全市社会消费品零售总额6832.48亿元，同比增长1.6%，其中通讯器材类零售额增长53.8%；深圳边检数据显示，同期口岸出入境外国人突破500万人次，入境消费活力持续提升。（央
text_en: In recent days, the Shenzhen Huaqiangbei commercial area has seen rising activity. A rich array of electronic products and rapidly iterating new releases have attracted tourists from many countries to shop. In Huaqiangbei, to welcome the National Day holiday, many merchants stocked new products in advance, and new robots and AI translation devices drew many overseas visitors to stop and look. Whether regulars who have visited Huaqiangbei many times or first-time tourists, all have felt the bustling consumption atmosphere here. Not only Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen has comprehensively improved the "China Travel, China Shopping" experience around the full range of inbound tourists' needs in dining, accommodation, transportation, sightseeing, shopping and entertainment. According to data from the Shenzhen Statistics Bureau, from January to August 2026, the city's total retail sales of consumer goods reached 683.248 billion yuan, up 1.6% year on year, of which retail sales of communication equipment rose 53.8%; data from the Shenzhen border inspection authorities show that during the same period, the number of foreign nationals entering and exiting at ports exceeded 5 million, and the vitality of inbound consumption continued to increase.
